browser.provisioning: Deferred operator environment prerequisite; no automatic download, installation or host change

negative_control.defect: Production WASM event emitter omits Failed for TaskError::Timeout; actual timeout result still settles

source_facts.browser_mode: WASM_BINDGEN_USE_BROWSER=1; Node remains default when no explicit test mode is selected
source_facts.headless: NO_HEADLESS must be absent; runner adds headless Chrome capabilities
source_facts.driver: CHROMEDRIVER selects a local executable; other driver and remote overrides are cleared
source_facts.discovery: Runner --list prints each exported test; zero tests otherwise returns success, so exact nonzero discovery must be checked
source_facts.output: Per-test failure is FAIL; final summary is test result: FAILED, not a native libtest FAILED per-test token
source_facts.serial: Pinned wasm-bindgen-test runtime uses concurrency 1; unsupported --test-threads is not passed

limitations: No browser/driver installed or launched; no tests, Cargo, syntax check or review run. Only the pinned Linux x86_64 local headless Chrome path is supported for browser evidence. Workers, Firefox, Safari, Edge, remote WebDriver and native-only discovery cannot substitute. Browser durability/page-loss and panic containment are not offered by this in-memory WASM pool.
